info.name: Get deleted records from a module

params.name: type
params.description: Specifies the type of deleted records to retrieve. Use 'all' to get all deleted records, 'recycle' for records in recycle bin, or 'permanent' for permanently deleted records.

params.name: page
params.description: To get the list of records from the respective pages. Default value for page is 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: To get the list of records available per page. The default and the maximum possible value is 200.

items.docs: Retrieve the deleted records for the module. This endpoint can retrieve both permanently deleted records and temporarily deleted records from the recycle bin.

params.name: parentRecordModule
params.description: The module name of the parent record (e.g., Contacts, Leads, Deals, Accounts, Services__s, Price_Books)

params.name: parentRecord
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent record. Must be a valid numeric record ID.

params.name: relatedList
params.description: The name of the related list (module) containing the records to retrieve or modify

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to include in the response. Field names must follow API naming conventions.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of records to return per page

items.docs: Retrieves a list of records that were previously related to a parent record but have since been deleted. Useful for audit trails and data recovery scenarios.
